Standards for Imposition of Administrative Fines (Related to Article 2)

1. General Standards
(a) The standards for imposing administrative fines according to the number of violations shall apply where a person has previously been subjected to an administrative fine for the same violation within the most recent three years. In such cases, the number of violations shall be calculated based on the respective dates on which an administrative fine was imposed for the violation and on which the same violation was detected again.
(b) The Minister of Health and Welfare may reduce the amount of an administrative fine prescribed in paragraph 2 by up to one half, taking into consideration the severity of the violation, its motive and consequences, and the circumstances following the violation.
